data.name: Knightmare
data.description: Your manifester level which granted you the terrors class feature gains a +2 bonus as long as this bonus doesn't raise your manifester level above your current Hit Dice. [ML bonus not implemented.] In addition, for the purpose of terrors level requirements and order benefits, add your dread and cavalier levels together. In addition, when declaring your challenge, you can make a free Intimidate check against the target.
